reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: middleware is a Next.js framework export (public API exception — no internal caller count required). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; attack entry point is unauthenticated external HTTP to /kiosk. Gate 3: src/app/kiosk/ and src/middleware.ts are explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the /kiosk HTTP endpoint by observing the URL in a browser bar, server access log, or Referer header, then replaying the ?token= value from a remote session to record fake attendance entries or trigger unauthorized NFC card registrations.
